pilot: P5 (synthetic G1: hard ODE vs soft PINN)
device: CPU only (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, torch.set_num_threads(1), at most 3 processes)

seeds.split: default_rng([20261104, 7, draw]) -> 12 of 63 conditions held out
seeds.lhs500: scipy LatinHypercube seed 12345 (rejection to the hull)

design: 63 ISU conditions x 251 cells, per-cell check-up weeks of data/processed/isu_capacity.csv (columns cell, group, week only)
pinn_arch: F = t g(t,x,z), g = tanh MLP 32x3, z in R^2; KAN [3,3,1] grid 5 in the law (same as hard ODE); Adam lr 5e-3 cosine to 10 %
collocation: (a) 24 times per training cell from record end (primary) or from 0 (whole_axis) to t_max=1.8; (b) 256 hull LHS stress points x 16 times in [0,1.8]; 512 + 256 rows resampled per step; no calendar twins (ISU has no storage arm)
window: first 4 check-ups after the initial one
go_rule: PINN forecast RMSE beyond the window below the hard ODE in >= 3 of 5 draws (primary variant record_end)
